title: Evaluation-transpose construction of equivariant Verdier exchange
statement:
Fix primes $p\ne\ell$, $a\ge1$, $q=p^a$, $k_0=\mathbf F_q$, an algebraic closure $k$ of $k_0$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ in a fixed algebraic closure $\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$, and $\Lambda\in\{E,\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell\}$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber]. For a finite-type $k_0$-scheme $T_0$ put $T=T_0\times_{k_0}k$, $g_T=\operatorname{id}_{T_0}\times\operatorname{Spec}(\operatorname{Frob}_q)$ with geometric Frobenius, and $P_T=Lg_T^*$ [def-weil-frobenius-detailed, def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom]. Use the rational/common-stage bounded constructible categories and Weil pairs $(K,\theta_K:P_TK\xrightarrow{\sim}K)$, whose arrows satisfy $u\theta_K=\theta_LP_T(u)$ [def-weil-weil-sheaf-complex]. Let $f_0:X_0\to Y_0$ be a separated finite-type morphism of finite-type $k_0$-schemes, and put $f=f_0\times_{k_0}k:X\to Y$. Assume $X_0,Y_0$ separated for the duality assertions. For $T=X,Y$ put $a_T:T\to s=\operatorname{Spec}k$, $\omega_T=Ra_T^!\Lambda_s$, and $D_T=R\mathcal Hom_T(-,\omega_T)$, using the constructible exceptional adjoint [def-weil-exceptional-inverse-image]. Use the canonical Weil lifts of the operations and their adjunctions, with equivariant units, counits, tensor evaluation and compact-support composition comparisons. Then $D_T$ lifts contravariantly to rational Weil pairs, its evaluation and biduality are equivariant, and the canonical comparisons
$$ \omega_{T,E}\otimes_E L\simeq\omega_{T,L},\qquad (D_{T,E}K)\otimes_E L\simeq D_{T,L}(K\otimes_E L) $$
for every finite $E\subset L\subset\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$ are equivariant, together with their evaluation, biduality and adjunction diagrams, also in the common-stage category.

Let $M$ be a Weil object on a domain where all following objects, tensor–Hom adjunctions, exceptional and ordinary adjunctions, and the displayed projection isomorphism are defined. Put $A=R\mathcal Hom_Y(Rf_!M,\omega_Y)$. Form
$$ Rf_!(M\otimes^LLf^*A)\xrightarrow{\operatorname{PF}^{-1}}Rf_!M\otimes^LA\xrightarrow{\operatorname{ev}}\omega_Y, $$
where $\operatorname{PF}$ is the specified projection map [def-exchange-projection], using the canonical tensor symmetry for evaluation if needed. Its successive exceptional, tensor–Hom and ordinary adjunction transposes define
$$ A\longrightarrow Rf_*R\mathcal Hom_X(M,Rf^!\omega_Y). $$
Let $c:Rf^!\omega_Y\simeq\omega_X$ be the mate of compact-support composition $a_X=a_Yf$, evaluated at the coefficient unit [def-weil-pbc-adjunction-mate]. Postcompose with $Rf_*R\mathcal Hom(M,c)$. This specific formal map
$$ D_YRf_!M\longrightarrow Rf_*D_XM $$
is equivariant. Each transpose is application of the corresponding lifted right adjoint after its unit; the mate expression for $c$ uses those units and counits and the pasting-compatible composition comparison. Under the hypotheses of [fix-lem-tensor-adjunction, fix-cor-verdier-exchange] the map is the inverse internal-adjunction isomorphism followed by $Rf_*R\mathcal Hom(M,c)$, so those theorems make it invertible and its inverse is equivariant. More generally equivariance holds wherever this same formal map and the displayed data exist, without claiming invertibility there or adding ambient exceptional-adjoint admissibility to the operation-lifting assertion. These identities use rational Weil isomorphisms themselves and require no invariant integral lattice.
